name: YMCA Camp Watchaug
description_short: A YMCA summer day camp (9am-4pm) on a 30-acre waterfront property on Watchaug Pond in Charlestown, RI, for campers from age 3 (Itty Bitty half-day camp, entering Pre-K) through entering grade 9. Ten weekly themed sessions, with Watersports and Rope Adventures specialty weeks, bus routes and extended day.
special_needs_notes: Toni's Kids is an inclusion program for children with emotional, developmental and intellectual disabilities. Specialized staff support these campers so they can join all regular activities alongside their peers. To check if your child qualifies, contact Camp Director Dori McGovern at dmcgovern@oceancommunityymca.org.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp sits on a 30-acre waterfront property on Watchaug Pond and has its own waterfront area. Swimming is part of camp, and the Gold Rush week includes an annual swim across the pond. Watersports specialty sessions run in weeks 2–8.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least one full week before a session for a full refund minus the $30 registration fee and $50 deposit; no refunds once a session begins or for weather or waterfront closures. Full refund if the YMCA cancels a session. Transfers between sessions are free if space allows.

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (2026 brochure, dates, handbook and bus schedule), and that summer is already over as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 information is posted yet. The session dates recorded here are for 2026.
Camp prices are not listed anywhere on the page. The dollar amounts on the page are facility rental and birthday party rates, not camp tuition.
The refund and $100 non-refundable deposit terms on the page are for facility rentals, not camp registration, so they were not recorded as camp policy.
The founding history contradicts itself: the camp is said to be founded in 1948 and also to have moved to its own grounds in 1948 after several years at Burlingame State Park.

The 'Watchaug SPECIALTY CAMPS SUMMER OF 2026' heading sits above the general themed weeks. Separate Watersports / Rope Adventures sessions are listed for weeks 2–8. It is unclear whether these are separate bookings.
Much of the page text is unrelated YMCA material (personal trainer bios, membership agreement).
